title: Code City Metaphors
description: Renders software as navigable cities where buildings are classes and districts are packages. Height shows size, color shows age or bugs; walking the city builds architectural intuition. It makes abstract structure physical.

demo.title: Demo — Code City Metaphors

title: 3D Call Graph Rendering
description: Draws call graphs in 3D AR space so dense graphs become explorable. Nodes float at arm's reach; edges show call volume by thickness. Rotation reveals structure flat graphs hide.

demo.title: Demo — 3D Call Graph Rendering

title: AR IDE Overlays
description: Overlays architecture diagrams onto the developer's real desk and screens. The code stays in the IDE; the big picture floats beside it, spatially anchored. Context switches drop.

demo.title: Demo — AR IDE Overlays

title: Headset Rendering Pipelines
description: Builds rendering pipelines hitting headset frame budgets: 90 fps, low latency. Level-of-detail, foveated rendering, and occlusion culling keep massive graphs smooth. Performance is the feature.

demo.title: Demo — Headset Rendering Pipelines

title: Gesture Navigation
description: Navigates code spaces with hand gestures: grab to move, pinch to zoom into a module. Gestures beat controllers for spatial exploration; the vocabulary stays small and consistent. It feels like handling the software.

demo.title: Demo — Gesture Navigation

title: Spatial Memory Anchoring
description: Anchors code elements to physical locations so spatial memory aids recall. The auth module lives by the window; developers remember where things are. It exploits how human memory actually works.

demo.title: Demo — Spatial Memory Anchoring

title: Heat-Map Overlays
description: Overlays heat maps — bugs, churn, coverage — onto the code city in AR. Hot spots glow; walking toward red finds the trouble. It directs attention physically.

demo.title: Demo — Heat-Map Overlays

title: Collaborative AR Review
description: Reviews architecture together in shared AR space with avatars and annotations. Reviewers point at the actual structure; discussions anchor to places. Remote reviews gain presence.

demo.title: Demo — Collaborative AR Review

title: Performance Budgets for AR
description: Enforces strict performance budgets so AR visualization never stutters. Frame time, draw calls, and triangle counts are capped; content scales to fit. Comfort depends on it.

demo.title: Demo — Performance Budgets for AR

title: WebXR Delivery
description: Delivers AR code visualization through WebXR in the browser, no app install. URLs become AR sessions; it lowers the barrier to trying visualization. Reach beats fidelity for adoption.

demo.title: Demo — WebXR Delivery

title: SLAM Anchoring
description: Anchors visualizations with SLAM so they stay put as users move. The device maps the room; content locks to real coordinates. Drift breaks trust, so anchoring quality matters.

demo.title: Demo — SLAM Anchoring

title: Occlusion Handling
description: Occludes virtual code correctly behind real objects for believable AR. Depth sensing hides buildings behind desks; without it the illusion breaks. Realism aids comprehension.

demo.title: Demo — Occlusion Handling

title: AR Accessibility
description: Designs AR visualization accessible to users with vision, motor, or vestibular limits. Seated modes, text alternatives, and comfort settings include everyone. Accessibility is a requirement, not a feature.

demo.title: Demo — AR Accessibility

title: Visualization Data Pipelines
description: Pipes repository metrics into AR scenes with incremental updates. Commits refresh the city; the visualization is always current. Pipelines make it a living tool, not a demo.

demo.title: Demo — Visualization Data Pipelines

title: Comprehension Evaluation
description: Evaluates whether AR visualization actually improves code comprehension with controlled studies. Task completion time and accuracy versus 2D baselines; the bar is evidence, not novelty. It keeps the field honest.

demo.title: Demo — Comprehension Evaluation
